per_task.question: ¿Qué dosis inicial de la vacuna CARVac recibieron los pacientes en el estudio de fase 1 BNT211-01?

per_task.question: What proportion of patients develop cytokine release syndrome after CAR T-cell therapy?
per_task.answer: Overall, about three‑quarters of patients develop cytokine release syndrome (CRS) of any grade after CAR T‑cell therapy, as reported in a large pediatric B‑cell ALL trial (77 % of patients) [PMID:29385370]. Severe CRS (grade ≥ 3) is less common, occurring in roughly 8–13 % of treated adults: a phase‑2 lymphoma study found a 13 % incidence of grade ≥ 3 CRS [PMID:29226797], and a meta‑analysis of 16 studies estimated a pooled rate of 8 % (95 % CI 0.03–0.12) for grade ≥ 3 CRS after CAR T‑cell therapy [PMID:38696731].
